metadata.title: Rugged Landscape Album Cover with Integrated Block Type

retrievalProfile.description: A cinematic landscape composition featuring a sharp mountain peak framed by massive, distressed block typography that spans the top edge.
excludeWhen: urban or indoor settings are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle photograph of a jagged, red-rock mountain peak under a cloudy sky, with a blurred figure in the foreground and heavy, textured orange block lettering integrated into the top third of the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Massive typography acting as a structural frame for the mountain peak
Contrast between the sharp mountain textures and the soft-focus foreground figure
Complementary color scheme of vibrant orange text against blue-grey sky and earthy red rocks
Horizontal bars in the lettering creating a sense of enclosure and stability
coreInvariants: The 'Z' in the display text must feature an elongated horizontal top bar that extends across the width of the composition.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The mountain peak is the central sharp subject; a blurred human figure occupies the lower center-right foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, vibrant orange 'MT. ZION' text at the top serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the heavy orange text, follows the mountain peak downward, and rests on the blurred figure in the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The sky provides limited negative space, mostly filled by the large-scale typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Earthy reds and browns of the canyon landscape.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted blue and grey of the overcast sky.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant, saturated orange used for the primary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic elements (text) contrasted with natural, medium-value tones in the photography.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick strokes with minimal counters
Horizontal bars extend to the edges of the frame
Distressed, grainy texture applied to the fill
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'Z' features a top bar that extends leftward to underline the preceding characters.
The 'M' and 'N' are condensed into square blocks.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Massive, textured geometric display type paired with a small, clean, wide-tracked serif for secondary information.

preserve: The extended horizontal bar of the 'Z'

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight for the display text.
Matches the wide-tracked, small-scale serif secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle photograph of a red-rock canyon with a prominent central peak under a cloudy sky. In the foreground, a man's head and shoulders are visible but out of focus, looking toward the mountain. Apply a vintage film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, ultra-bold orange block text at the top. The text should have a grainy texture. Extend the top bar of the 'Z' across the entire width. Add a small, wide-tracked serif name in dark blue on the right side below the main text.

verificationChecks: Is the top text orange and distressed?
Does the 'Z' have an elongated top bar?
Is the foreground figure out of focus?
Is the mountain peak sharp and centered?

mustAchieve: Tactile, weathered texture on graphic elements

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the orange text feels integrated into the scene via texture.
Verify the horizontal bar of the 'Z' creates a clear framing line.
Check that the foreground figure does not distract from the mountain peak.
Confirm the color palette remains earthy and naturalistic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a sharp natural landmark with a blurred human element, then frame the top with heavy, textured, geometric typography that utilizes extended horizontal strokes.
